QuestInfo.name: Not the Right Way
QuestInfo.0: Carson, the Zenumist President has something to ask of you in secret. Go speak with Carson.
QuestInfo.1: Carson, the Zenumist President is requesting that you ruin #b#MDmirrorD_326_1_##k so that no experiments against humanity cannot be carried out by Alcadno.
QuestInfo.2: You ruined #MDmirrorD_326_1_# as Carson, the Zenumist President requested but you think that this might be a personal revenge by Carson.

0.0: It's just horrible. Breathe life into a machine? This goes against every single law of nature. \r\n#L0##bBut if everything has to go with nature, why do we have science and magic?#l\n#k
0.1: What a preposterous question! Science proves natural law, and magic is a natural byproduct of nature. Wait...you don't buy into those weird teaching of Dr. De Lang, do you? \r\n#L0##b...#l\n#k
0.2: Creating life is the domain of gods! We have no right... As the head of the Zenumist Society, I cannot allow this. But if I were to handle this situation with my own hands, it would just make the situation worse... So, I will need your help.

yes.0: Go immediately to #b#MDmirrorD_326_1_##k and destroy the laboratory so that the Alcadno can no longer carry out their vile experiments against humanity.

no.0: Are you perhaps supporting these inexcusable experiments by the Alcadno?

1.0: Is the Alcadno Laboratory no more?

yes.0: I am sure Maed is fuming. Ahh, I wish I could see that. Cheeks puffing, face turning beet red... Ah, good work.

default.0: Go tear up #b #MDmirrorD_326_1_##k so that the Alcadno can no longer carry out their inhumane experiments.
